title: It is unclear where the entry Carbs came from
body:
Last night at 2.15 it is unclear from where there was a record of 96 grams of carbs. 96 is the max allowed carbs according to the settings. Around this time, I made a bolus for correction of 1.5 units through the button Insulin, but carbs were not introduced. As a result, AAPS started injecting SMB, which led to hypoglycemia.
I use AAPS 3.1.0.3, Nighscout 14.2.5.
